OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

- `openapi.yml` — added `email` to the `OwnerFields` schema (optional). This regenerates `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` with the field, so it flows through the MapStruct mapper automatically (no mapper edits needed) and appears in responses.

- `InvalidEmailException` + `InvalidEmailExceptionHandler` + escalation YAML — respond 400 with `{"errors":["email"]}`, matching the telephone handler's shape.
- `owners.POST.yml` and `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` — wired in a `normalizeEmail` step, so both create and update normalize/validate consistently.
- `ApplyOwner` — copies `email` onto the loaded entity for the update path.

Both POST (via `BuildOwner` → mapper) and PUT (via `ApplyOwner`) reuse the one `NormalizeOwnerEmail` step, so the validate-and-lowercase logic lives in exactly one place.
